name: Artint original synthetic research diagnostics v1
provenance: Original fictional stories, questions and expected spans authored for this repository under MIT. No publisher text or model output is used as gold.
selection_protocol: Eight fictional story families, each with two answerable questions and one unanswerable question. Purposive engineering fixtures, not a representative sample or held-out model benchmark.
